scenes.summary: Senior Originium Physicist Aquito tells you that her team found a special Protocol Space aboard Dijiang that they have named the "Valley's Aberrants". She hopes you can help investigate the Valley's Aberrants to ensure the safety of Dijiang.

lines.text: No anomalous readings. Energy activity fits model A. Good, now it's time to test the...
Hold on. Let me jot down these numbers first...
Hold on. Let me jot down these numbers first... And yes, I just reported to the General Technological Committee.
Aquito. Senior Originium Physicist. As you can see, I'm conducting research work right now.
The main Protocol-Originium structure of Dijiang recently exhibited an unexpected jolt of activation. Shortly afterwards, one of our operators found this portal.
The readings we're getting from it are extremely ... interesting. As of now, we have discovered at least thirty signal patterns never recorded before.
And this is exactly why I invited you here. We need an explorer to investigate this, and none is more suitable than you.
None of our scouting drones made it back. Interference is just too strong. It's a Protocol Space, after all.
And due to this very reason, the General Technological Committee has determined that it is very likely to pose a safety hazard to Dijiang.
Now, given your ... intimate connection to Protocol-Originium, your involvement might be the safest option available to us.
Thank you for your understanding. Don't worry. I'll be right here monitoring the status of the Valley's Aberrants.
If things get too hot, I'll execute an emergency bootloader and extract you from the Protocol Space. So, why don't we get started right now?

Given our current observations, we have given this Protocol Space a temporary name: "Valley's Aberrants". Many of the things within it might look similar to those in the real world, but they are wholly different as well.

scenes.summary: Aquito is preparing the device to actively change the Valley's Aberrants portal and transform the Protocol Space. The goal is to grant you the necessary support for exploring the place.

lines.text: Endmin, come take a look at this! We got a new set of interesting data!
Oh, that's true. Endmin, are you alright?
The scan we made even detected a temporary disappearance of the portal, but it quickly reverted to its original form.
The device can now reliably identify more types of data... Endmin, I think I got some ideas.
There might be other entities similar to the "key target" in the Valley's Aberrants. They probably serve as the "index" for the zones around them.
I'll use the material samples we gathered and try to influence this portal, transform the Protocol Space, and provide you with necessary support.
I got something for that. This device has been furnished with some experimental energy interference measures. I believe we can use it to "restructure" the place.
Understood... We should be able to take care of that. Let's start upgrading a few specific exploration support tech.
Let's call them the "Aberrant Cores". Once we decipher them, my device should help expand the zones you can explore.

options: And I just fought a really hard battle...
How about some TLC for your Endmin?
...I'm fine. Much appreciated.
But the nearby roads are blocked.
Explosives are what I need right now.
Rocks are in the way. Big rocks.

scenes.summary: Aquito has discovered the repeated "restorative" property of the Valley's Aberrants. She believes this property can be leveraged to achieve something.

lines.text: The size of the Valley's Aberrants portal has just increased by 0.3%. Well done.
I'm not saying the place has been affected by the Æther, but it seems odd when the readings could return to the same initial ranges after such extreme fluctuations.
Perhaps the "contamination" is just a change of state. Perhaps we never truly approached it, and only entered a specific instance of it...
This is simply amazing. An entity that is stable yet active, dangerous yet secure.
I'll be giving you additional research commissions to help upgrade our exploration support tech. Time to hasten our exploration efforts.
I compared the data. Even when Derangement reached dangerous levels, ambient readings quickly dropped back to the initial baseline after you left.
We can definitely achieve something substantial if we could leverage these properties.

options: You're really interested in the research...
Did we make any progress?
Aquito... Aquito...?
Sounds great to me.

r: You're really interested in the research...

scenes.summary: Aquito has extracted you quickly after detecting strong fluctuations in the depths of the Valley's Aberrants. At the same time, Xaihi also reports strange energy fluxes in the engine room sections of Dijiang.

lines.text: Endmin?! Endmin! Are you alright?
I was just walking by when I saw you giving off a lot of smoke and collapsing on Aquito... Your suppressor seems to have experienced a temporary overload.
Apologies. The Depth levels gave off fluctuation frequencies even higher than the sum of all our previous attempts. I had to extract you with max power.
But nothing out of the ordinary took place inside. Why did it react so strongly in this dive...?
Endministrator, Supervisor Perlica, there is an emergency.
The Engineering Division has detected an abnormal energy fluctuation in the engine room sections. The entire hull of Dijiang may have experienced a slight tremor.
...Understood. Please head to the Control Nexus. We'll troubleshoot this together.

options: I think so, for now...
...I'm still seeing two of you.

r: I think so, for now...
...I'm still seeing two of you.

scenes.summary: You discover that the root cause of changes to the Valley's Aberrants might be located in the north polar Aurora Circle. This hazardous region is severely affected by the Ætherside.

lines.text: What's the situation, Xaihi?
Calm has returned, but we have yet to identify the cause of the tremor.
Self-diagnostic results of every vessel system are normal. Dataloggers of the engine room sections registered zero non-conforming readings prior to the occurrence of the energy fluctuation.
If none of our internal machineries were at fault, does that mean the problem lies elsewhere...?
Fifteen minutes before the energy fluctuation, Dijiang was starting a total Talos-II environment scan of our monthly plan.

To help direct our telemetric arrays, the vessel adjusted its orientation so that its length is aligned with the scanning path. This process continued till the occurrence of the incident being discussed.
And what was the location we were scanning when the incident took place?
Regression analysis under way... Incident took place at 1203 hours 56 seconds. The target of the scanners was ... the north polar Aurora Circle.
The Aurora Circle is located in the most dangerous areas north of the Civilization Band. It is also the very frontlines garrisoned by the Order of Steel Oath.
The Ætherside dominates the realspace within the Aurora Circle. The entire region is extremely hostile to us.
Endmin, we should inform Aquito of this. Xaihi and I will continue to monitor the vessel and ensure there are no further risks.

options: What was Dijiang doing when the incident took place?
Give me the latest vessel status log.
You don't look very well, Perlica.
Is that a dangerous place?
That may very well be the cause of this.

r: What was Dijiang doing when the incident took place?

scenes.summary: Aquito has a solution to combat the tendency of Valley's Aberrants to external interference. She wants you to go as deep as you can in the Valley's Aberrants and perform a total scan of the final Aberrant Core.

lines.text: Really? That really helped to explain things...
The core of Dijiang is a single, massive formation of Protocol-Originium. When the vessel aligned itself at the Aurora Circle, its center of mass also got closer to that location.
This slight shift might explain the interference of the Valley's Aberrants and caused the Protocol Space to rapidly collapse from within.
The planet scanning plan runs on a schedule and we can simply avoid those scanning days. However, there's no denying that the Valley's Aberrants is extremely vulnerable to external interference.
How ironic. We spent all our time figuring out how to handle this dangerous Protocol Space ... only to end up brainstorming for solutions to keep it safe.
I referenced data from our previous scans. There should be one more Aberrant Core in the Valley's Aberrants.
I will have a proper solution ready for our next exploration dive. Please help retrieve the data. I need a total scan that is more thorough and comprehensive.
I cannot guarantee that the solution would work, but if it did ... it would mean we have struck the jackpot and found the treasure vault.
...Ah, just a temporary metaphor for describing my baseless imaginations.
In any case, we'll get started once you're ready. This will be the most important exploration attempt of all.
I will. And if my hypothesis gets validated, I hope I could use the budget and apply for a bottle of champagne.
Now, we can get started once you're ready. This will be the most important exploration attempt of all.

options: Sounds like a touchy, sensitive thing...
But we can't stop our work because of this, right?
So, any solutions so far?
Treasure vault?
Give me the complete details once I come back.

r: Sounds like a touchy, sensitive thing...

scenes.summary: Aquito hopes to keep exploring the Valley's Aberrants and establish this Protocol Space as a "pocket realm" for Endfield.

lines.text: The same fluctuation curve has been detected, and with a 97% match... Success! I am truly a genius in this field of science!
The scan we just did gave us the essential data we need to construct the Valley's Aberrants algorithmic model.
I referenced the simulation results, then made the device provide a data feed of a completely artificial energy pulse. The Valley's Aberrants actually responded in kind and within my expectations.
We're definitely on the right way! All we need is to keep perfecting the model! We'll eventually find a way to use this portal and "manipulate" the entirety of the Valley's Aberrants!
That's the least minimum we can do. Various laws and models can now be used to influence the Protocol Space portal ... and change the structure, energy, and physical nature of the Aberrants.
Every Protocol Space now has the potential to become the perfect experimental site — a "pocket realm" that is safe, unrestricted, impeccable, and wholly owned by Endfield!
Endmin, our spatial construction model is just a very rudimentary framework right now. You can keep exploring the place to acquire more field data.
This is just the beginning of our research. Let us work together and unveil all the secrets of the Protocol Space!

Of course. This is the work of the best minds in Protocol Space research. The Engineering Division spared no expense to move it from planetside.

Thankfully the device isn't too affected. After a cursory analysis, we believe it still has the ability to maintain an interspatial comm channel. Some of the data still match.
I can even say that certain pieces of identifiable data have become more stable... I'll adjust the parameters and continue to record readings from this portal.
It's even responding to energy inputs... Does that mean... Ah! Apologies.

scenes.summary: Aquito has realized that the Valley's Aberrants only generates items and objects from your recent experiences. You must speed up your exploration efforts.

lines.text: We've done exploring the newest zone. Thankfully the Blight has hardly messed with our monitoring sensors.
But after checking the video feeds and images, there's something that I'm really concerned about...
Try remembering everything you encountered in the Aberrants. It doesn't matter if they make sense or not. You actually saw all of them in Valley IV, right?
Endmin, I have a feeling that we'll discover something even more valuable.
Hmm... That means the Valley's Aberrants only contained things from your recent experiences. Our temporary name for it just happens to be exceedingly accurate.
Very unusual. The structure of the Protocol Space should be random, yet the insides of the Valley's Aberrants seem extraordinarily "ordered".
It's like a cloudbeast stomping around on piano keys and somehow composing a proper melody. That itself is extremely strange.

options: Factories, machines, Aggeloi, Landbreakers... That's right.
